title: Rank Frontiers and Sharp Descendant Bounds for Proximal Identification in a Binary Star
banked_reason: D0.5.G: the sound exact law-by-law frontier and positive fiber remain a narrow binary-star population result with paper score ceiling 6.1 below the 7.4 field floor; a field-level inference upgrade is a distinct research program.
gap_reasons: The nonidentified branch has constant latent outcome channels and the nontrivial bounds concern descendant Z in a narrow binary star; Schott separation is only for the stated operation menu; no sampling result or substantive use raises practical reach.

The proposed rank-adaptive confidence set is a distinct inference research program requiring a sampling model, nonregular boundary analysis, confidence-set geometry, uniform coverage, and contraction/rates—not a bounded same-scope D0 repair.
proof_attempt_summary: The run completed the population mathematics: an exact causal rank frontier, a complete positive observed-law fiber, rational intervention maps, sharp fixed-arm and two-arm descendant bounds, and maximal identified linear summaries. The field-tier promise collapsed on reach rather than correctness: the model is a narrow binary star with constant latent outcome channels on the nonidentified branch, and its operation-menu separation is deliberately limited. Reaching field tier would require a separate rank-adaptive inference program with an explicit sampling model and uniform nonregular coverage theory.
tldr: For the strictly positive binary star with unknown invertible \(L,R_0,R_1\), the full two-arm intervention law has an exact observable rank frontier. The complementary confounded rank-one-outcome laws have a complete positive fiber and rational target image, yielding sharp fixed-arm descendant bounds, a finite-candidate sharp two-arm descendant contrast bound, and a classification of every identified two-arm linear score. Informative-arm spectral recovery is credited to Allman et al. A separate result limits Schott’s specified operation menu, without claiming general proximal completeness or priority for overlapping bound formulas.
gap: KurokiPearl2014 and Allman2015 establish informative-view recovery, but their inspected sufficient theorems do not classify every attainable positive law when both outcome views collapse, nor give the complete positive singular fiber for this full descendant-containing district. Duarte2026 raises unresolved priority for related sharp-bound formulations because only its abstract is accessible. Schott2026’s specified kernel operations can consume target proxies.
fill: Establish the full-district iff frontier and complete positive observed-law fiber, derive its rational causal image and fixed-arm consequences, and prove the narrowly specified Fix/Obf/Tbf/Ebf operation-set separation. The bound formula is positioned as a consequence of this particular fiber, without a broad sharp-bound priority claim.
